body:
WOTAN/store.html: real IDUNA email/password login, resolves the player's GFD character, browses the hat catalog, buys/equips hats against IDUNA's real Phase 1 endpoints via a new same-origin /api/ nginx proxy. Linked from index.html. JS syntax-checked; not yet reachable from outside since the WOTAN subdomain itself isn't deployed (WOTAN-DNS-001 still queued on sudo). Found and fixed a real security gap along the way in IDUNA (hats buy/equip had no ownership check). WOTAN commit 6ca9196, BRAWLPIT docs commit 7cb2f3e, IDUNA fix commit 9537796.

⚓ ☃
title: WTHS-0000 Phase 2: WOTAN hat store page shipped (code-complete, not yet live)
